verse.text: The Lord is like a father to his children, tender and compassionate to those who fear him.

video.title: The Love of a Father | Psalm 103:13 [Daily Devotional]

reflection: You don't have to have it all figured out to be a good dad — you just have to be tender toward your kids the way God is tender toward you. Compassion isn't weakness; it's a father noticing when his kid is struggling and choosing patience over frustration. Next time your child messes up, try responding the way you wish your own dad or God himself responds to you: gently, not harshly.
